sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Non-Statutory & Extra-Constitutional**: NITI Aayog is neither a constitutional body nor a statutory body; it was created via an executive resolution of the Union Cabinet.
• **Cooperative Federalism**: Employs a 'Team India' approach, involving all State Chief Ministers and Lieutenant Governors in decision-making through its Governing Council.
• **Think Tank Role**: Acts as the nodal agency providing directional, policy, and strategic inputs to both Central and State governments, discarding the 'one-size-fits-all' model.
• **No Financial Allocation Powers**: Unlike the erstwhile Planning Commission, NITI Aayog possesses **no power to allocate funds** to states or ministries; it is purely an advisory think tank.
• **Twin Pillars**: Built around 'Team India Hub' (representing states with the Centre) and 'Knowledge and Innovation Hub' (building NITI's internal think-tank capabilities).

items.title: Major Geographical Distribution / Regional Hubs
items.content:
• **Aspirational Districts**: Heavily concentrated in the 'Red Corridor', central and eastern mineral-rich belts, and remote border/hilly regions.
• **Aspirational Blocks Programme**: Extension of the district model focusing down to the block level across diverse geographical terrains.

items.title: Challenges, Reforms & Forward Strategy
items.content:
• **Bottlenecks / Issues**: Lack of statutory financial teeth, reliance on line ministries for implementation, variable state-level administrative capacities.
• **Policy Interventions**: Data-driven governance, outcome-based monitoring, real-time dashboards, and integration of AI and green tech in planning.

items.title: Mnemonic for NITI Aayog Composition/Structure
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym / Phrase**: 'P-G-V-C' (Prime Minister Governs Various Councils)
• **Decoded Meaning**: Prime Minister (Chairperson), Governing Council (CMs + LGs), Vice-Chairperson (appointed by PM), Chief Executive Officer (CEO appointed by PM).
• **Prelims Exam Value**: Instantly eliminates incorrect options regarding statutory board members or financial powers.

items.title: Retention Rule of Thumb
items.content: • **Core Formula / Rule**: NITI = Think Tank + No Money. Whenever a Prelims statement mentions NITI Aayog allocating plan funds or approving state budgets, it is factually INCORRECT.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC frequently states that NITI Aayog approves the Five-Year Plans or allocates central plan funds to states. This is false; the Planning Commission did that, but NITI Aayog has no financial allocation powers.

Mains Value Addition: In GS-2 or GS-3, quote NITI Aayog's transition from 'command-and-control planning' to 'indicative, cooperative, and competitive federalism' to showcase deep structural understanding.

keyTakeaways: NITI Aayog is a non-statutory, extra-constitutional executive body functioning as the premier policy think tank of India.
It operates on the philosophy of cooperative and competitive federalism through indices, the Governing Council, and flagship missions like ADP and AIM.
Unlike the erstwhile Planning Commission, it possesses zero financial allocation powers, acting purely in an advisory, collaborative capacity.
